meaning: The sample's scaffold of the logistic science build with direct insertion (one copy, 40 packs a second of the config's 240 over 6; logistic-science-240-direct-insert-clock-fixtures.ts) under the generator's euclidean_swings clock for the config (made with backpressure at its belt pickups); the disturbances are the inserters taken off every belt, then the two output loaders removed (the molten iron comes from infinity pipes and has no loss). `native` is the run under the game tests' protocol, timed in game ticks (tests/game/helpers/lua/steady.lua), recorded in Factorio 2.1.24: steady state (the machines making the target have made it over the trailing 3,600 ticks, no less than a window of whole clock cycles earlier), a baseline judged by net output over its whole clock cycles (the final machines' products less the output stock they gained; 3,600 ticks unless the fixture names a longer one), then each disturbance until the output falls below the baseline's lowest minute, released and recovered; `stock` is the output stock guard (the run fails when the final machines' output stock at its end is below the lowest of the baseline's whole cycles; null for a build judged by a count). The probe records the run, the verdicts are computed host-side (tests/game/helpers/run-judgement.js). `generation` is the selection the family's generation test pins, with the sha256 of its exported clock's identity (`clockIdentity`); `recorded` is the recording that is current.

recorded.note: recorded under the protocol in game ticks on the engine of this head with the tests of the branch that added it; pr is set when the PR is opened
